title: Delay Goodwill Schedule for Mobile Wallet Shortfalls
content:
Goodwill schedule for **Mobile Wallet** credits that arrived short.

**Delay goodwill.** The days a shortfall stood are counted in calendar days to the date of the error-found decision, from the starting date of the shortfall period. The delay goodwill on a shortfall make-good follows those days:

| Days the shortfall stood | Delay goodwill |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 5.0 percent |
| at least 5 and fewer than 10 | 2.5 percent |
| fewer than 5 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, decision dated 2026-07-20)

| Shortfall period starts | Days stood | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-16 | 4 | nothing |
| 2026-07-15 | 5 | 2.5 percent |
| 2026-07-11 | 9 | 2.5 percent |
| 2026-07-10 | 10 | 5.0 percent |
